in_marathi.name: Ashnoor
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Moonlight, Night Sky
in_marathi.long_meaning: Ashnoor हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Ashnoor is a Sanskrit name derived from the Asha tree and the word 'noor', which means light. It symbolizes the radiance of the moonlight on the night sky. In Hindu mythology, it is believed that the Asha tree is a wish-fulfilling tree, and the name Ashnoor is given to girls born under the auspicious moonlight.
